lines.t: I'm staring at the night sky
Trying to find the right words
All these lights above me
But I'm thinking about you
It's quiet but my heart's loud
Going through it all
Every step, every fall, you were there through it all
And I didn't even notice all the times you pulled me through
Now I'm looking at the stars with tears in my eyes
Yeah, we're sure you've been here the whole time
Through the pain, through the nights I felt alone
You were holding on when I let go
I don't know how you love me like you do
But I feel it right now and I know it's true
Yeah, I'm standing here overwhelmed by your heart
Looking at the stars
I remember all the nights I was lost in my own way
Didn't think that you were near Didn't think that you would stay
But you stayed Through my doubt, through my shame
You never walked away Now I see a clear room
You were always right here
Even when I couldn't feel it
You were closer than I knew
Now I'm looking at the stars with tears in my eyes
Yeah, I'm sure you've been here the whole time
Every moment I was breaking down inside You were standing there right by my side
I don't have the words to thank you for it all But I feel your love every time I call
Yeah, I'm standing here overwhelmed by your heart
Looking at the stars
I was blind but now I see You were right in everything
Every tear, every scar Led me back to where you are
And I'll never be the same Now I know your name
Every breath I take I'm giving you the praise
Looking at the stars with tears in my eyes
Yeah, well, sure, you've been here my whole life
Now I know I was never alone
You were with me all along
And I'll never forget what you've done for me
Every moment was your mercy
Now I'm here with my heart open wide
Looking at the stars tonight
You were there, you were always there
